PLUGIN_HOSTD_HISTORY_KEYS.doc: The keys of a line of the running-history file, in the order the daemon writes them (docs/design/notes/2026-10-27-grouping-planner.md, The history record): history <uri> <binary digest> <host class> key=value ..., after the header line '# plugin-hostd history/1'. The value of every key is a whole number or a decimal, never negative. A line with a key outside these words is kept as it is by every save and never read.

first.doc: UTC seconds of the first window.

last.doc: UTC seconds of the last window.

windowsSolo.doc: Windows the plugin ran in a worker of its own.

windowsGrouped.doc: Windows the plugin ran in a worker of two or more.

cpuP95Solo.doc: Percent of one core, the worker's utime plus stime over a window, an estimate of the 95th percentile of the windows run alone.

cpuMaxSolo.doc: Percent of one core, the largest window run alone.

pssMbSolo.doc: MiB, the Pss of the worker's smaps_rollup, the largest window run alone.

xrunWindowsSolo.doc: Windows run alone in which JACK counted at least one xrun.

xrunWindowsGrouped.doc: Windows run in a group in which JACK counted at least one xrun.

crashesSolo.doc: Worker deaths of a worker of its own that the daemon attributed to the plugin.

crashesGrouped.doc: Worker deaths of a group that the daemon attributed to the plugin.

restartsGrouped.doc: Worker deaths of a group the plugin was a member of and was not the culprit of.

quarantines.doc: Times the supervisor quarantined the plugin.

lastCrash.doc: UTC seconds of the last crash the plugin was blamed for alone.

lastCrashGrouped.doc: UTC seconds of the last crash the plugin was blamed for in a group.
